preguntaEn: WHICH OF THE FOLLOWING IS NOT A CHARACTERISTIC OF A FRONT TIRE FAILURE?
opcionesEn: VEHICLE FISHTAIL.
STEERING WHEEL TWISTING.
DIFFICULT STEERING.

preguntaEn: THERE ARE SEVERAL THINGS TO DO WHEN DRIVING THROUGH A HIGHWAY WORK ZONE. IN ADDITION TO OBEYING THE SPEED LIMIT, WHICH OF THESE SHOULD YOU ALSO DO?
opcionesEn: TURN OFF YOUR 4 WAY FLASHERS.
DECREASE YOUR SPEED EVEN FURTHER FOR ADVERSE WEATHER.
ADJUST YOUR SPEED TO TRAFFIC.

preguntaEn: YOUR VEHICLE IS IN A TRAFFIC EMERGENCY AND MAY COLLIDE WITH ANOTHER VEHICLE IF YOU DO NOT TAKE ACTION. WHICH OF THESE IS A GOOD RULE TO REMEMBER AT SUCH A TIME?
opcionesEn: YOU CAN ALMOST ALWAYS TURN TO MISS AN OBSTACLE MORE QUICKLY THAN YOU CAN STOP.
STOPPING IS ALWAYS THE SAFEST ACTION IN A TRAFFIC EMERGENCY.
LEAVING THE ROAD IS ALWAYS MORE RISKY THAN HITTING ANOTHER VEHICLE.

preguntaEn: WHENEVER YOU DOUBLE YOUR SPEED, IT TAKES ABOUT_______ TIME AS MUCH DISTANCE TO STOP.
opcionesEn: TWO.
THREE.
FOUR.

preguntaEn: HOW CAN YOU IDENTIFY A DISTRACTED DRIVER?
opcionesEn: THE VEHICLE IS DRIFTING ACROSS LINES AND MOVING AT VARIABLE SPEEDS.
THE VEHICLE IS WEAVING IN AND OUT OF TRAFFIC.
THE VEHICLE IS SPEEDING.

preguntaEn: SOMETIMES YOU NEED TO LEAVE A ROAD TO AVOID A HAZARD OR EMERGENCY. WHEN YOU DO SO YOU SHOULD KEEP IN MIND, THAT:
opcionesEn: MOST SHOULDERS ARE NOT STRONG ENOUGH TO SUPPORT A HEAVY VEHICLE.
YOU MIGHT BE UNABLE TO RE- ENTER THE ROAD BECAUSE OF THE GRAVEL USED ON SHOULDERS.
IT IS LESS DANGEROUS TO DRIVE ONTO THE SHOULDERS THAN TO MAKE A COLLISION.

preguntaEn: CARGO INSPECTION:
opcionesEn: IS MOST OFTEN NOT THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE DRIVER.
SHOULD BE PERFORMED AFTER EVERY BREAK YOU TAKE WHILE DRIVING.
ARE NEEDED ONLY IF HAZARDOUS MATERIALS BEING HAULED.

preguntaEn: BRAKE DRUMS (OR DISCS) MUST NOT HAVE CRACKS LONGER THAN _______ THE WIDTH OF THE FRICTION AREA.
opcionesEn: ONE-HALF (1/2).
ONE-THRID (1/3).
ONE TENTH(1/10).

preguntaEn: RETARDERS:
opcionesEn: CAN CAUSE THE DRIVER WHEELS TO SKID WHEN THEY HAVE POOR TRACTION.
ALLOW YOU TO DISCONNECT THE STEERING AXLE BRAKES.
CANNOT BE USED ON INTERSTATE HIGHWAYS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT STAYING ALERT TO DRIVE IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: A HALF-HOUR BREAK FOR COFEE WILL DO MORE TO KEEP YOU ALERT THAN A HAFL-HOUR NAP.
IF YOU MUST STOP TO TAKE A NAP, IT SHOULD BE AT A TRUCK STOP OR OTHER REST AREA, NEVER ON THE SIDE OF THE ROAD.
SLEEP IS THE ONLY THING THAT CAN OVERCOME FATIGUE.

preguntaEn: THE PRIMARY CAUSE OF FATAL CRASHES IS:
opcionesEn: DRIVING AT NIGHT.
DRIVING WHILE EATING.
DRIVING TOO FAST.

preguntaEn: YOU WISH TO TURN RIGHT FROM ONE TWO-LANE, TWO WAY STREET TO ANOTHER. YOUR VEHICLE IS SO LONG THAT YOU MUS SWING WIDE TO MAKE THE TURN.
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD SWING WIDE WHEN YOU BEGIN THE TURN.
YOU SHOULD SWING WIDE WHEN YOU COMPLETE THE TURN.
YOU SHOULD NOT MAKE A TURN. DRIVE STRAIGHT TO THE APROPPIATE INTERSECTION.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A DANGER OF A ROUGH ACCELERATION?
opcionesEn: MECHANICAL DAMAGE.
TIRE DAMAGE.
DAMAGE TO COUPLING.

preguntaEn: WHEN STARTING A BUS ON A LEVEL SURFACE WITH GOOD TRACTION THERE IS OFTEN NO NEED FOR:
opcionesEn: A TIRE CHECK.
THE PACKING BRAKE.
SLOW ACCELERATION.

preguntaEn: YOU WILL KNOW IF THE VEHICLE YOU ARE DRIVING IS EQUIPPED WITH ABS BRAKES BY:
opcionesEn: RED INDICATOR LAMPS ON THE BRAKE CYLINDERS.
THE CERTIFICATION ON THE DRIVER-SIDE-DOOR.
WHEN YOU TURN ON TH IGNITION, YELLOW ABS MALFUNCTION LAMPS LIGHT UP ON THE INSTRUMENT PANEL.

preguntaEn: IF YOU MUST STOP INTO THE ONCOMING LANE AS YOU MAKE A TURN, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: WATCH FOR AN ONCOMING TRAFFIC.
COMPLETE YOUR TURN WITHOUT STOPPING.
BACK UP TO ALLOW THE ONCOMING TRAFFIC TO PASS.

preguntaEn: TO CORRECT A DRIVE WHEEL BRAKING SKID, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: STOP BRAKING.
STOP BRAKING, TURN QUICKLY, AND COUNTERSTEER.
INCREASE BREAKING, TURN QUICKLY, AND COUNTERSTEER.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD AVOID DRIVING THROUGH DEEP PUDDLES OR FLOWING WATER. BUT IF YOU MUST, WHICH OF THESE STEPS CAN HELP TO KEEP YOUR BRAKES WORKING.
opcionesEn: GENTLY PUTTING ON THE BRAKES WHILE DRIVING THROUGH THE WATER.
APPLYING HARD PRESSURE ON BOTH THE BRAKE PEDAL AND ACCELETATOR AFTER COMING OUT OF THE WATER.
TURNING ON YOUR BRAKE HEATERS.

preguntaEn: WHICH MAY BE A SIGN OF TIRE FAILURE?
opcionesEn: WHEELS SKIDDING.
A LOUD HISSING NOISE.
VIBRATION.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING A HEAVY VEHICLE WITH A MANUAL TRANSMISSION. YOU HAVE TO STOP THE VEHICLE ON THE SHOULDER WHILE DRIVING ON AN UPHILL GRADE. WHICH OF THESE IS A GOOD RULE TO FOLLOW WHEN PUTTING IT BACK IN MOTION UP THE GRADE?
opcionesEn: KEEP THE CLUTCH SLIPPING WHILE SLOWLY ACCELERATING.
USE THE PARKING BRAKE TO HOLD THE VEHICLE UNTIL THE CLUTCH ENGAGES.
LET THE VEHICLE ROLL BACKWARDS A FEW FEET BEFORE YOU ENGAGE THE CLUTCH, BUT TURN THE WHEEL SO THAT BACK MOVES AWAY FROM THE ROADWAY.

preguntaEn: STAB BRAKING SHOULD NOT BE USED ON VEHICLE WITH:
opcionesEn: TRAILERS.
HAZARDOUS MATERIALS.
ANTI-LOCK BRAKES.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING A 40-FOOT VEHICLE AT 35 MPH. THE ROAD IS DRY AND VISIBILITY IS GOOD. WHAT IS THE LEAST AMOUNT OF SPACE THAT YOU SHOULD KEEP IN FRONT OF YOUR VEHICLE TO BE SAFE:
opcionesEn: 3 SECONDS.
4 SECONDS.
5 SECONDS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A PROPER USE OF VEHICLE LIGHTS?
opcionesEn: TURNING ON YOUR HEADLIGHTS DURING THE DAY WHEN VISIBILITY IS REDUCED DUE TO RAIN OR SNOW.
FLASHING YOUR BRAKE LIGHTS TO WARN SOMEONE BEHIND YOU THAT ARE SLOWING DOWN.
FLASHING YOUR BRAKE LIGHT TO GET SOMEONE OFF YOUR TRAIL.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS A DANGER OF CROSSING RAILROAD TRACKS ON DIRT ROADS?
opcionesEn: THE GROUND UNDERNEATH THE TRACKS MAY NOT BE STABLE.
YOU COULD GET HUNG UP HALFWAY ACROSS THE TRACKS.
YOU TIRES COULD SINK INTO THE DIRT AND NOT CROSS THE TRUCKS.

preguntaEn: HOW MUCH SPACE IN FRONT OF YOU IS NEEDED WHILE DRIVING ON A HIGHWAY?
opcionesEn: 1 SECOND FOR EACH 10 FEET OF VEHICLE LENGTH.
1 SECOND FOR EACH 20 FEET OF VEHICLE LENGTH.
1 SECOND FOR EACH 30 FEET OF VEHICLE LENGTH.

preguntaEn: TRUCKS AND BUSES ARE SUBJECTS OF CERTAIN LAWS, REGULATIONS AND RESTRICTIONS. WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: COUNTY AND CITY LAWS DO NOT APPLY TO TRUCKS AND BUSES ENGAGED IN INTERSTATE COMMERCE.
FEDERAL REGULATIONS APPLY ONLY TO TRUCKS AND BUSES DRIVEN AT LEAST 50 MILES ON A TRIP.
LAWS AND RESTRICTIONS CAN VARY FROM PLACE TO PLACE.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT ENGINE OVERHEATING IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD NEVER SHUT OFF AN OVERHEATED ENGINE UNTIL IT COOLS.
YOU SHOUL NEVER REMOVE THE RADIATOR CAP ON A PRESSURIZED SYSTEM UNTIL THE SYSTEM IS COOLED.
ANTIFREEZE IS NOT NEEDED WHEN THE WEATHER IS WARM.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS IS TRUE ABOUT USING ENGINE BRAKE?
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD USE THE ENGINE BRAKES AS A MAIN WAY TO CONTROL YOUR SPEED.
INCREASING USE OF THE ENGINE BRAKE PREVENTS EXTRA FRICTION BETWEEN THE BRAKE SHOES APART OF THE DRUM.
THE USE OF THE BRAKE ON A DOWNGRADE ADD TO THE BRAKING EFFECT OF THE ENGINE.

preguntaEn: A FULL STOP IS REQUIRED AT A RAILROAD CROSSING WHEN:
opcionesEn: THERE ARE NO FLAGMEN, WARNING SIGNALS, OR GATES AT THE CROSSING.
THE NATURE OF THE CARGO MAKES A STOP MANDATORY UNDER STATE OR FEDERAL REGULATIONS.
THE CROSSING IS LOCATED IN A CITY OR TOWN WITH FREQUENT TRAIN TRAFFIC.

preguntaEn: CONTROLLED BRAKING:
opcionesEn: CAN BE USED WHEN YOU ARE TURNING SHARPLY.
INVOLVES LOCKING THE WHEELS FOR A SHORT PERIOD OF TIME.
IS USED TO KEEP A VEHICLE IN A STRAIGHT LINE WHEN BRAKING.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS TRUE REGARDING THE USE OF DRUGS WHILE DRIVING?
opcionesEn: NO PRESCRIPTION OR NON-PRESCRIPTION DRUGS ARE ALLOWED AT ANY TIME WHEN YOU DRIVING.
USE OF AMPHETAMINES LIKE ‘’SPEED’’ IS ALLOWED IF YOU ARE USING THIS DRUG TO STAY ALERT.
PRESCRIPTION DRUGS ARE ALLOWED IF A DOCTOR SAYS THE DRUGS WILL NOT AFFECT THE DRIVING ABILITY.

preguntaEn: WHERE SHOULD THE IGNITION KEY BE DURING THE TRIP INSPECTION?
opcionesEn: IN YOUR POCKET.
IN THE IGNITION.
ON THE DRIVER SEAT.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THE FOLLOWING CAN KEEP YOU FROM BEING DISTRACTED WHILE YOU DRIVE?
opcionesEn: TRY TO USE COMMUNICATION DEVICES ONLY IN LIGHT TRAFFIC.
CONSTANTLY REVIEW YOUR MAPS AND YOUR ROUTE PLAN AS YOU DRIVE.
PRE-LOAD YOUR FAVORITE CDs OR CASSETTE TAPES.

preguntaEn: A HAZARD:
opcionesEn: IS ANY ROAD CONDITION OR OTHER ROAD USER THAT IS POSSIBLE DANGER.
CANNOT TURN INTO EMERGENCY.
DOES NOT NEED TO BE SEEN.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENT ABOUT USING TURN SIGNALS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: YOU DO NOT NEED TO USE YOUR TURN SIGNAL WHEN CHANGING LANES IN TRAFFIC ON A FOUR-LANE HIGHWAY.
WHEN TURNING, YOU SHOULD SIGNAL EARLY.
YOU SHOULD USE YOUR TURN SIGNAL TO MARK YOU VEHICLE WHEN IT IS PULLED OFF ON THE SIDE OF THE ROAD.

preguntaEn: WHAT HAPPENS TO TAR IN ROAD PAVEMENT DURING HOT WEATHER?
opcionesEn: IT BECOMES GUMMY, MAKING TIRES STICK TO THE ROAD.
IT BLEEDS, MAKING THE ROAD SURFACE SLIPPERY.
NOTHING, IT IS MADE FOR HOT WEATHER.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE DO NOT PROVIDE EXTRA GEARS ON SOME TRUCKS?
opcionesEn: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION.
AUXILIARY TRANSMISSION.
MULTI-SPEED REAR AXLES.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING A HEAVY VEHICLE. YOU MUST EXIT A HIGHWAY USING AN OFF-RAMP THAT CURVES DOWNHILL. YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: SLOW DOWN TO A SAFE SPEED BEFORE THE CURVE.
SLOW TO THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT FOR THE OFF-RAMP.
WAIT UNTIL YOU ARE IN THE CURVE BEFORE DOWNSHIFTING.

preguntaEn: WHEN DRIVING AT NIGHT, YOU SHOULD USE YOUR LOW BEAMS WHEN AN ONCOMING VEHICLE IS WITHIN:
opcionesEn: 300 FEET.
400 FEET.
500 FEET.

preguntaEn: WHICH O THESE IS A GOOD THING TO DO WHEN STEERING TO AVOID A CRASH?
opcionesEn: APPLY THE BRAKES WHILE TURNING.
DON’T TURN ANY MORE THEN NEEDED TO CLEAR WHAT IS IN YOU WAY.
AVOID COUNTERSTEERING.

preguntaEn: WHAT IS COUNTERSTEERING?
opcionesEn: TURNING THE STEERING WHEEL COUNTERCLOCKWISE.
USING THE STEERING AXLE BRAKES TO PREVENT OVERSTEERING.
TURNING THE WHEEL BACK IN THE OTHER DIRECTION AFTER STEERING TO AVOID A TRAFFIC EMERGENCY.

preguntaEn: WHEN THERE IS A VEHICLE FIRE, GET YOUR VEHICLE OFF THE ROAD AND:
opcionesEn: PUT OUT THE FIRE.
KEEP THE FIRE FROM SPREADING.
NOTIFY EMERGENCY SERVICES.

preguntaEn: IF A STAIGHT VEHICLE ( NO TRAILER OR ARTICULATION) GOES INTO FRONT-WHEEL SKID, IT WILL:
opcionesEn: SLIDE SIDEWAYS AND SPIN OUT.
GO STRAIGHT AHEAD EVEN IF THE STEERING WHEEL IS TURNED.
GO STRAIGHT AHEAD BUT WILL TURN IF YOU TURN THE STEERING WHEEL.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD STOP DRIVING:
opcionesEn: AFTER 5 HOURS.
AFTER 9 HOURS.
WHENEVER YOU BECOME SPLEEPY.

preguntaEn: IMPLIED CONSENT MEANS:
opcionesEn: YOU HAVE GIVING YOUR CONSENT TO INSPECTION OF YOUR VEHICLE FOR ALCOHOL.
IT IS UNDERSTOOD THAT YOU MAY DRINK ALCOHOL NOW AND THEN.
YOU HAVE GIVEN YOUR CONSENT TO BE TESTED FOR ALCOHOL IN YOUR BLOOD.

preguntaEn: YOU MUST DRIVE ON SLIPERY ROAD. WHICH OF THESE IS A GOOD THING TO DO IN SUCH A SITUATION?
opcionesEn: USE A SMALLER FOLLOWING DISTANCE.
APPLY THE BRAKES WHILE ON CURVES.
SLOW DOWN GRADUALLY.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING ON STRAIGHT LEVEL HIGHWAY AT 50 MPH. THERE ARE NO VEHICLES IN FRONT OF YOU. SUDDENLY A TIRE BLOWS OUT ON YOUR VEHICLE. WHAT SHOULD YOU DO FIRST?
opcionesEn: STAY OFF THE BRAKE UNTIL THE VEHICLE HAS SLOWED DOWN.
BEGIN LIGHT BRAKING.
BEGIN EMERGENCY BRAKING.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT SPEED MANAGEMENT IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: SHADY PARTS OF THE ROAD ALLOW BETTER TRACTION THEN DO OPEN AREAS.
ROAD SUFACE WILL FREEZE BEFORE BRIDGES.
WHEN THE ROAD IS SLIPPERY, IT WILL TAKE LONGER TO STOP AND IT WILL BE HARDER TO TURN WITHOUT SKIDDING.

preguntaEn: IF YOU HAVE CONVICTED OF DRIVING A COMMERCIAL VEHICLE UNDER INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOL OR DRUGS, YOU WILL LOSE YOUR CDL FOR AT LEAST________.
opcionesEn: 6 MONTH.
1 YEAR.
2 YEAR.

preguntaEn: WHAT SHOULD YOU DO BEFORE DRIVING IN MOUNTAINS?
opcionesEn: KNOW SCAPE RAMPS LOCATIONS ON YOUR WAY.
UNHOOK YOUR STEERING AXLE BRAKE.
CARRY TIRE CHAIN IN YOUR VEHICLE.
